summary: A retail-heavy morning dominated by festive season capacity investments and international brand expansions, alongside significant Reliance IPO valuation signals seeking $114 billion for Jio Platforms.

bullets.text: Amazon India investing Rs 2,800 crore to add 50% capacity ahead of 35-40% festive demand spike.
Jio Platforms seeking $114 billion valuation in IPO planned for October 21, sources confirm.
Korea's CJ Foods launches Bibigo Bapsang in India; GTGO targets Rs 100 crore revenue and 100 outlets by June 2027.
KIKO Milano plans to double store network, targets India entry into top 3-5 global markets within five years.
NCLT achieved highest-ever quarterly performance approving resolution plans despite ongoing staff vacancies.
